text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Getting injured, of all things... I'm so 
sorry for making you worry...
choice_data_list:
Just to be safe, let's get plenty of rest 
today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That's true, but...
choice_data_list: 念のために、今日はしっかり休もう
choice_data_list_en: Just to be safe, make sure to get plenty of rest today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Can't I move around just a little 
bit, please?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a scheduled training day, 
taking a break just feels kind of 
unsettling...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As for how my injury is doing, I'm totally 
fine! ...Please!
choice_data_list:
To be safe, you should get some rest right 
now.

To be safe, you should get some rest right 
now.

If we keep an eye on things, then just a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As for how my injury is doing, I'm totally 
fine! ...Please!
choice_data_list: 大事をとって、今は安静にするべきだ
大事をとって、今は安静にするべきだよ
様子を見つつ、少しだけなら……
choice_data_list_en: To be on the safe side, you should rest for now.
To be safe, you really should rest for now.
If it's just a little bit while seeing how things go...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything happens to go wrong, even all 
my past efforts will come to nothing.
choice_data_list: 大事をとって、今は安静にするべきだ
大事をとって、今は安静にするべきだよ
様子を見つつ、少しだけなら……
choice_data_list_en: To be on the safe side, you should rest for now.
To be safe, you really should rest for now.
If it's just a little bit while seeing how things go...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Effort to heal an injury... I see...
choice_data_list: ケガを治す努力をしよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's focus our efforts on healing your injury.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's so true! Working hard isn't just 
about training non-stop, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll make sure to get plenty 
of rest!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I feel kinda fidgety... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation rested quietly in order to 
heal her injury.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's fine with me. I'll proceed 
carefully too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while carefully monitoring her 
condition, we did some light training, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —...gh, nngh...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. It seems I misjudged the 
severity of the injury."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I was too naive, su... For now, I'll just 
rest up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation's injury has worsened... 
There is no choice but to rest for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Phew――
choice_data_list:
With this training routine, everything 
should be fine.

With this training routine, everything 
should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's no pain at all, so I can keep 
going like this.
choice_data_list: このメニューなら、問題なさそうだな
このメニューなら、問題なさそうだね
choice_data_list_en: With this routine, there shouldn't be any problems.
With this routine, there shouldn't be any problems.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll continue to be careful. I 
definitely want to avoid pushing myself 
and making the injury worse here!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation worked within her limits to 
stay active and aim for her comeback.
